recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a bounded HTTP-page correction for FHIR-7929 and does not require duplicate commits for the already-audited related Meta/versioning issues.
issue_request: FHIR-7929 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for the DSTU1 FHIR-core HTTP page, asking that create-time version metadata support be conditional on server versioning support while retaining SHALL when versioning is supported.
initial_application: The Jira comment records svn revision 5341. Git commit 97095030bb8d07af7c80ef6c0c7f7b76f460bc85 (#7929) changed only the update metadata paragraph in source/http.html to be conditional on version support, leaving parallel create and Location-header wording unconditional.
additional_context: Current source/http.html says no-version servers must omit Resource.meta.versionId and update Resource.meta.lastUpdated correctly. FHIR-14222 and FHIR-11259, already represented on the combined branch, support that later interpretation: lastUpdated is server-updated for REST operations, but versionId may be omitted when versioning is unsupported.
reconciliation: Changed source/http.html update/create metadata text to separate always-populated meta.lastUpdated from version-supported meta.versionId, and made Location-header descriptions for update-created resources, conditional updates, create, and conditional create conditionally include Version Id only when versioning is supported.
source_changes: source/http.html:744-746 now requires meta.lastUpdated and makes meta.versionId conditional on version support for update.
source/http.html:762-771 now makes Version Id in update-created Location headers conditional on versioning support.
source/http.html:875 and 1359 now make repeated conditional update/create Location-header descriptions conditional on versioning support.
source/http.html:1264-1285 now makes create metadata and Location-header Version Id conditional on versioning support while keeping id and lastUpdated populated.

related_jiras.note: Later Published Meta handling issue confirms lastUpdated is server-updated for REST operations while versionId may be updated or removed; it is already represented on the combined branch.
Later Published clarification confirms no-version servers need not carry meta.versionId; it is already represented on the combined branch.
